new_items.notes: Unnumbered worked division of x^3+2x^2-3x-7 by x-2 gives quotient x^2+4x+5 and remainder3, then explains f(2)=3.
Given a polynomial divided by another of degree n, explain that the remainder is zero or has degree less than n. This is a conceptual remainder-degree question, not another numerical division.
Use the previously shown y=|x| graph to explain why |x|<2 is equivalent to -2<x<2. The two half-plane cases must be combined as one open interval.
Three progressive long-division stages divide 2x^3-3x^2+x-6 by x-2. Arrowed callouts explain leading-term division, subtraction, quotient and zero remainder.
